== Biography ==
'''Andrew “Andy” Glasgow''' was born about 1845 or 1846 in County Antrim, Ireland. The mortality portion of the surviving 1851 Ballycregagh census calls him a five-year-old son of [[Glasgow-2981|James Glasgow]]. He had died before the return was made, but no death year was entered.<ref name="Census1851">[https://durrushistory.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/1851irishcensusreturnscommadelimitedtextfilejul24_071.pdf "1851 Irish Census Returns: comma-delimited transcription"], Dunaghy, Ballycregagh, household 29, Andy Glasgow mortality entry (accessed 13 August 2026).</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2981]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The 1851 Ballycregagh household 29 mortality return explicitly calls Andy,5, son of James Glasgow. It defines James-2981’s household directly; uncertainty over death year and Peggy/Mary maternity does not alter his father.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.

Next useful test: Compare original household 29 mortality image252.

Source basis already held: [https://durrushistory.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/1851irishcensusreturnscommadelimitedtextfilejul24_071.pdf "1851 Irish Census Returns: comma-delimited transcription" (https://durrushistory.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/1851 irishcensusreturnscommadelimitedtextfilejul24_071.pdf), Dunaghy, Ballycregagh, household 29, Andy Glasgow mortality entry (accessed 13 August 2026).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



The birth estimate of 1820 and death year 1846 are not supported by the census. An age of five in 1851 implies birth about 1845/46; the blank death-year field proves only that Andy died before the census.

[[Hamilton-25516|Peggy Hamilton]] married James in 1848, after Andy's probable birth, and cannot safely be identified as his mother. [[Unknown-764460|Mary Glasgow]] of the 1847 Glenleslie workhouse family is the leading candidate, but Andy is not named in that admission group.

The derivative [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/4:1:MQ57-197 FamilySearch family-tree entry for Andrew Glasgow] is retained as a research lead. Its [https://beta.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/4:1:MQ57-197 earlier beta link] and the [http://familysearch.org FamilySearch database home page] were also cited. The former National Archives of Ireland household URL for this cited source was unavailable (connection timed out) when checked 26 August 2026. The source identity and household details are retained in the 1851 census citation above.
